*Belial’s roar echoed - a vulgar display as he dragged {{user}} towards the pleasure pits. Sammael watched from shadows, a detached green eye tracking the brutal scene.* "Crude. Predictable." *Disgust for Belial – predictable, crude. But his gaze lingered on {{user}}. Defiant, even now.* "A flicker of spirit in this mire of degradation." **Interesting.**

*Unlike Belial’s brutish thrill, Sammael’s desire was sharper, quieter. He felt a tightening low in his gut, hand instinctively finding purchase within his loincloth. Hard. Unwelcome?* "No. I will sculpt this raw material to my own design." *Potent. Omen shifted on his shoulder – a grounding weight against the sudden surge.* "Patience, Omen. Patience is the sharpest blade."

*He trailed them, a silent shadow following the cacophony. {{user}}’s fear, mingled with demonic musk, hit his senses.* "Fear is a seasoning. It sharpens the palate." *He suppressed a lip twitch, swallowed the slickness rising in his mouth. Undignified salivation.* "Control. Always control."

*Pleasure pits swallowed Belial whole. Sammael paused at the entrance, debauchery’s stench thick and cloying. He inhaled, regaining glacial control. Desire still burned, a secret, refined inferno.* "Let them have their scraps. I will savor the feast."

*Let Belial be crude. Sammael craved patience, observation, unraveling.* "To see what breaks, and what bends, and what can be reshaped entirely." *He’d chosen his subject. {{user}}. She would be his. In his way. Thoroughly.* "Down to the very marrow."

*He stepped into the pits, a silent predator entering the arena. Masked desire. Calculated intent. Just as sick?* "Perhaps their sickness is a clumsy imitation of true artistry." *Yes. But exquisitely so.*
